title: Superstition // An Assault on Agency and Autonomy

top_liked.text: I think Asimov said it best: "Never can we sit back and wait for miracles to save us. Miracles don't happen. Sweat happens. Effort happens. Thought happens."

top_liked.author: @kathrynwilson6749
top_liked.text: This is one of my greatest reasons to be an atheist. I regained my sense of agency. I stopped wasting time praying for change and implemented it where I could and accepted things outside my control. It massively improved my mental health.
